'''Hollé''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served as one of the [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens|handmaidens]] of the [[Royal House of Naboo|Royal House]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]].<ref name="VE" /> Shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars]]<ref name="ROTS" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]].</ref> Hollé attended the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|funeral]] of [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], who had served as the [[senator]] for Naboo up until her [[death]]. During the ceremony, which was held in the [[city]] of [[Theed]], Hollé walked alongside another handmaiden in front of the [[gualaar]] pulling Amidala's coffin and behind the [[Gungan]]s [[Jar Jar Binks]] and [[Rugor Nass]]. She had [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s and light skin. During the funeral, she wore a dark red hooded [[cloak]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hollé appeared in the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="ROTS" /> The funeral scene was filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[September 16]], [[2003]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="VE" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was created by [[Leland Chee]] for the ''[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]'' department of [[Star Wars Insider 142|''Star Wars Insider'' 142]],<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|142|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Loyal to their Queen!}}</ref> a magazine published on [[June 10]], [[2013]].<ref name="InsiderDate">{{SWArchive|url=news/get-the-inside-scoop-on-star-wars-insider-142.html|text=Get the Inside Scoop on Star Wars Insider #142}}</ref>
